summary.text: Soft Vajra Wind Chief is Wu Yong's immortal killer move that forms huge bluish-black humanoid wind chiefs.

claims.text: Against Feng Jiu Ge and Fang Yuan, fierce wind around Wu Yong subsides into gentle rotating breeze, then into enormous figures shaped like humans but tall like elephants, with bluish-black bodies, stone-like bulging muscles, sharp fangs, thick arms that droop to their feet, wholly black eyes, and green hair all over. He activates the immortal killer move Soft Vajra Wind Chief and creates six wind chiefs at once. Some shout with loud wheezing noises and some scream at an almost ear-piercing pitch; they split into two groups of three, one charging Feng Jiu Ge and the other chasing Fang Yuan. Feng Jiu Ge’s long range palm strikes send resonant sound waves that stop all six and send them back so they look unable to resist. Wu Yong keeps pressing with them while he lashes a wind whip, and later while Finger Wind Dragon presses Feng Jiu Ge; with the dragon’s speed and the six soft vajra wind chiefs still pressing him, Feng Jiu Ge cannot interrupt Wu Yong’s next preparation.
Later use tying down enemies on Heavenly Court’s battlefield.
On Heavenly Court’s battlefield Wu Yong uses soft vajra wind chief among other killer moves, alternating with wishful wind whip, yin wind rope, and more to tie down enemies.
